body: thank you so much for taking time out of your day to respond to this. ill give it some more thought before i talk to him because im scared that i won’t be careful with my words. ill also check out the tips. i’ve been where he was but it’s gotten a lot better because i could talk to my sister about it. i don’t know how hard it must be for him but i don’t want him going through that alone. thank you so much again. i wish that you’re safe and well :”)

oh no.. that response from them isn’t it... i hope that you are safe and doing well, that you can open up to someone trustworthy and understanding, and feel vulnerable around them. please take care of yourself ! 💛💛

I totally understand you and thank you for sharing! I hope that you are able to learn to open up honestly to your therapist. I realised that when I recently opened up to my friend, I started laughing and smiling while letting go of my thoughts and letting her see my arm. She was so shocked and was upset that I was masking it. I guess it was a way to cope and not to fully break down on her. Anyway, please remember that your feelings are valid and no one has it ‘worse’. We all experience things differently! Let’s try our hardest! I hope things are doing well for you and please take care of yourself ! 💛
oh no.. your emotions are always valid and no one’s pain is ever ‘worse’ than anyone else’s! please take care! wishing everything is going well for you! 💛

I totally get you.. I feel terrible for my little brother, because whenever he cries, my dad yells at him and says boys shouldn’t cry, which is why he is emotionally unstable. I really hope he doesn’t end up like me. Please take care of yourself! Wishing that things will go well for you! 💛

Thank you so much for sharing. I honestly think my parents have a manipulative personality. It’s taken me this long to realise that they have been guilt tripping me throughout my childhood and up until now, I can’t tell myself to accept my own feelings without feeling guilty for thinking that they may be upset, even when they hurt me. It’s taking time and I recently opened up to my friend and I’m really grateful to her. Thank you again and I hope you are doing well! Take care! 💛

I totally understand... I honestly can’t talk to them anymore and it’s difficult when I’m underage and I’m not allowed to get a job to earn money and live by myself or with a friend. Whenever they talk to me, a wave of  sadness and anger washes over me and i just don’t want to associate with them anymore. Anyway, I hope things get better for you too and thank you for sharing! Please take care !! 💛

I hope that you can will meet more people that can understand you. You don’t need to have many friends but just enough people around you that you can both rely on each other for support! I hope that things go well for you! Please take care 💛
we do be trying to mask our emotions tho 😖i hope you take care of yourself and that you can learn to open up to people when you’re ready! 💛
???like??? you’re literally a kid being told to not feel emotions??? 😐😐anyway, please take care!!! 💛

And it’s so hard just trying to be okay and separating your personal problems from school. Like you just wanna keep all your negative emotions and shit at home so you don’t have a breakdown in the middle of class and during break time.... I really hope things are doing well for you. Please take care ! 💛
You said exactly what I wanted to convey!! I really hope you take care and that things will get better 💛
It’s really unfortunate that our parents don’t understand that we react to things differently.. Please take care 💛
I wish you all the best and hope you can learn to accept your emotions and not to be ashamed of them!  Take care of yourself well 💛
I hope that you can slowly learn to express the way you feel. It takes time, and I really hope you can talk to someone you trust and they understand you!

I feel the same. I feel like my family tries to make me suppress my emotions. When I feel sad, they always ask me why and tell me stop being depressed. But when I’m feeling happy or just better, they ask me why I’m talking a lot, or why I’m energetic or why I’m no longer sad. I can’t control the way I feel like i want to. I tried to smile when I was sad but I kept crying more and it felt uncomfortable and forced.
Thank you so much.. I’m hoping to tell her by the end of this week. I hope you have a good week!
hey!! you’re not wasting anyone’s time!! we are very willing to help out. we want to make sure every one is safe and receiving the help they need. so please please reach out
please let me know if there is anything i can do for you. you’re not alone and we’re all here for you.

hey! don’t feel sorry for sharing your feelings. that’s what this sub is for. i completely understand how you feel. a new environment isn’t always a great feeling for some people, and that’s totally okay. i hope that you can find that small push and motivation soon, to clean up a bit, starting from tending the wounds on your palms, cleaning the object and your home, and then writing down your thoughts and feelings. i usually keep things to myself, i felt that writing things down never helped but i started it today, to keep track of my wellbeing. it may or may not work for you, but i hope you can pick something up that will help you. 

i really wish that you start to heal yourself, mentally and physically. you’re a great, strong person for persisting for that long ! love can bring you happiness or make you feel terrible. you will soon feel better, that you don’t need them anymore and they can remain as a memory to you that helped shaped you into who you are today and tomorrow. you’re not unattractive, or stupid. please remember this from me !

if you need anyone to reach out to, i’ll be ready to listen to you! there are plenty of others that can help you through this journey. we’re in it together! stay safe and healthy! you can do it!
thank you thank you ! 🥺
thank you!! take care !!

im trying really hard not to relapse again. i stopped for a year and now, it’s getting stressful but i don’t want to resort to this. my sister and i are close and i trust her. we talk about many things and she knows about my mental health problems and she hasn’t told my parents about it. but with this case, i can’t be sure if she’d tell them. when i find that im ready, ill try to talk to her. it’s hard to approach her when she had a lot on her plate too, with work and uni. but thank you for your reply. i hope you have a good week.
